definitions.explanation: Having or showing a firm determination to do something, without hesitation or wavering. Often used to describe someone's attitude or demeanor when making a difficult decision.

examples.japanese: {決然|けつぜん}とした⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{立|た}ち{上|あ}がった→立ち上がる：02128_tachiagaru⟧。
examples.english: He stood up with a determined expression.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{決然|けつぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{辞表|じひょう}→辞表：27086_jihyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}した→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧。
{決然|けつぜん}たる⟦{意志|いし}→意志：01712_ishi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ち{向|む}かった→立ち向かう：06981_tachimukau⟧。
examples.english: She faced the difficulties with firm resolve.

notes:
A たる/⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ adjective-adverb. Used in three main patterns: {決然|けつぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ + verb (resolutely ~), {決然|けつぜん}とした + noun (resolute ~), and the literary {決然|けつぜん}たる + noun (resolute ~). Carries a literary, somewhat elevated tone.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {決然|けつぜん}とした⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: a resolute attitude
- {決然|けつぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{立|た}ち{上|あ}がる→立ち上がる：02128_tachiagaru⟧: to stand up resolutely
- {決然|けつぜん}たる⟦{意志|いし}→意志：01712_ishi⟧: firm will

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{毅然|きぜん}→毅然：09174_kizen⟧: firm, resolute — more about moral strength and composure under pressure
- ⟦{断固|だんこ}→断固：12714_danko⟧: firm, decisive — stronger emphasis on being unyielding; often used with ⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧ or ⟦{拒否|きょひ}→拒否：08242_kyohi⟧
- ⟦{果敢|かかん}→果敢：07934_kakan⟧: bold, daring — adds a nuance of bravery in the face of danger
